headline: What Does Amazon.com (AMZN) Backing A Texas Gas Plant Mean For Its Climate Pledge?
summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) has been confirmed as a key financial backer of a large private gas power plant built to supply its new data center campus in Texas. The project is expected to support Amazon's growing cloud and AI computing needs while relying on fossil fuel based generation. The scale of the plant means it could become one of the largest single sources of greenhouse gas emissions in the US, drawing scrutiny of Amazon's public climate targets.
